item.title: A BBC Owner's Mandelbrot on the Commodore 64
item.description:
After the BBC Micro Mandelbrots the obvious next stop was the machine on the other side of the playground. I never had a Commodore 64. I was a BBC kid, so the C64 was something I saw at friends’ houses, loading games off tape while we argued about which was better. Writing a program for one feels like visiting a foreign country where I don’t speak the language.

So I had Claude be my guide. It drove the VICE emulator through its remote monitor, typing the program in at the READY. prompt while I watched the window, just like it did with the BBC.
